# Antigravity Design System: Full Reference Manual

> An agent-native, human-centric design system standard built for high visual precision, physical intuition, and rigorous software engineering.

## 1. Eighteen Core Directives

1. Physical Yield on pointerdown: Interactive controls compress to scale 0.97-0.98 immediately on pointerdown.
2. Zero Layout Shifts: Never change border-width, font-weight, tracking, padding, or margin on hover/focus/active.
3. Tabular Numerals: Counters, prices, metrics, and line numbers declare tabular-nums.
4. Accessible Invariants: Every icon-only button carries an explicit aria-label; modals trap focus and dismiss on Escape.
5. Quiet Chrome & Anti-Pill: Avoid reflexive bordered card grids and decorative eyebrow pills above headings.
6. Concentric Corner Radii: Nested corners obey R_inner = max(0, R_outer - Padding).
7. Anti-Crush Architecture: Declare explicit page archetypes, W_col >= 340px, and shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap pills.
8. Reversible Kinetic Affordances: Icons animate along mechanical paths that return cleanly to rest on pointer leave.
9. Component Dimension Invariants: Never override h-*/w-* variants with trailing size-full or size-auto inside cn().
10. Optical Icon Proportion: Pass explicit numeric size={...} matching 40% to 50% of parent height.
11. Perceptual OKLCH & Dual Contrast: Gradients interpolate in oklch with WCAG 2.2 AA and WCAG 3 APCA contrast floors.
12. British English & Clean Prose: Zero AI em dashes, zero banned marketing buzzwords, strict British English spelling.
13. Origin Anonymity: Present all guidelines, tokens, and components as self-contained standards of this system.
14. Telemetry Indicator Cadence: Pulse animations rest >= 60% of cycle at opacity 0 and animate compositor properties only.
15. Brand Truth & Fact Integrity: Never invent synthetic metrics, fake testimonials, or unverified brand hex colours.
16. Micro-Finish & Baseline Stability: Reserve min-h-[1lh] for form helper/error slots and cap containers at 1440px.
17. Evidence Before Assertions: Execute empirical verification gates and confirm exit code 0 before reporting done.
18. Autonomous Rulings: Record minor design-engineering rulings and maintain forward build velocity.

## 2. OKLCH Token & Dual-Engine Contrast Ledger

### Light Mode Pairs
- Body Text on Canvas (--foreground on --background): oklch(0.145 0 0) on oklch(1 0 0) | WCAG 2.2 19.79:1 | APCA Lc 108.9 | PASS
- Card Foreground on Card (--card-foreground on --card): oklch(0.145 0 0) on oklch(1 0 0) | WCAG 2.2 19.79:1 | APCA Lc 108.9 | PASS
- Primary Button Ink (--primary-foreground on --primary): oklch(0.985 0 0) on oklch(0.205 0 0) | WCAG 2.2 17.16:1 | APCA Lc 105.1 | PASS
- Secondary Button Ink (--secondary-foreground on --secondary): oklch(0.205 0 0) on oklch(0.97 0 0) | WCAG 2.2 16.42:1 | APCA Lc 101.4 | PASS
- Muted Label on Canvas (--muted-foreground on --background): oklch(0.54 0 0) on oklch(1 0 0) | WCAG 2.2 5.06:1 | APCA Lc 77.8 | PASS
- Destructive Intent (--destructive-foreground on --destructive): oklch(0.985 0 0) on oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325) | WCAG 2.2 4.56:1 | APCA Lc 75 | PASS
- Success Intent (--success-foreground on --success): oklch(0.985 0 0) on oklch(0.51 0.16 145) | WCAG 2.2 5.15:1 | APCA Lc 78.5 | PASS
- Warning Intent (--warning-foreground on --warning): oklch(0.205 0 0) on oklch(0.75 0.16 70) | WCAG 2.2 7.81:1 | APCA Lc 62.1 | PASS
- Info Intent (--info-foreground on --info): oklch(0.985 0 0) on oklch(0.52 0.18 245) | WCAG 2.2 5.04:1 | APCA Lc 77.9 | PASS

## 3. Fluid Motion Springs

- Tactile: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 600, damping: 30, mass: 0.8 }`
- Dialog: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 350, damping: 35, mass: 1.0 }`
- Snappy: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 550, damping: 35, mass: 0.6 }`
- Micro: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 700, damping: 40 }`
- Squishy: `{ type: "spring", stiffness: 420, damping: 24, mass: 0.8 }`

## 4. Primitive Building-Block Reference (57 Components, 470 Kinetic Icons)

### Accordion (`@/components/ui/accordion`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/accordion.md`
- Defining Constraint: Expands and collapses vertical disclosure panels smoothly via CSS height transitions under Base UI ARIA keyboard controls.
- Use When: FAQs, collapsible inspector subsections, or compact mobile configuration groups. Progressive disclosure blocks allowing multiple peer panels open simultaneously.
- Anatomy: `<Accordion defaultValue={["item-1"]}> <AccordionItem value="item-1"> <AccordionTrigger>Quiet Chrome</AccordionTrigger> <AccordionContent>Typography and whitespace replace card noise.</AccordionContent> </AccordionItem> </Accordion>`
- Metadata: Accessible vertical disclosure stack with smooth CSS height reveal.

### AlertDialog (`@/components/ui/alert-dialog`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/alert-dialog.md`
- Defining Constraint: Forces explicit user acknowledgement via high-friction modal focus trapping that blocks accidental backdrop dismissal.
- Use When: Irreversible destructive operations such as deleting repositories, revoking production API keys, or discarding unsaved work. High-consequence billing or security actions requiring explicit Cancel vs Confirm choice.
- Anatomy: `<AlertDialog> <AlertDialogTrigger className={buttonVariants({ variant: "destructive" })}>Revoke Key</AlertDialogTrigger> <AlertDialogContent> <AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogTitle>Revoke key?</AlertDialogTitle> <AlertDialogDescription>Traffic using this token stops immediately.</AlertDialogDescription> </AlertDialogHeader> <AlertDialogFooter> <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel> <AlertDialogAction>Revoke Key</AlertDialogAction> </AlertDialogFooter> </AlertDialogContent> </AlertDialog>`
- Metadata: High-friction confirmation modal requiring explicit user acknowledgement.

### Avatar (`@/components/ui/avatar`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/avatar.md`
- Defining Constraint: Deterministically computes harmonious OKLCH fallback colours from initials while cleanly supporting presence pips and overlapping AvatarGroup stacks.
- Use When: Team member identity badges, commit actor nodes, comment headers, and presence bars. Compact collaborator groups with deterministic fallback monograms.
- Anatomy: `<Avatar size="default"> <AvatarFallback autoColor>WD</AvatarFallback> <AvatarBadge status="online" /> </Avatar>`
- Metadata: User identity emblem with deterministic OKLCH fallback and status pip. | Sizes: xs, sm, default, lg, xl | Props: autoColor, max, size, spacing, status

### Badge (`@/components/ui/badge`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/badge.md`
- Defining Constraint: Locks shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap operational pills with tabular numerals and optional resting-plateau pulse indicators; banned above titles as decorative eyebrow kickers.
- Use When: Operational telemetry (`healthy`, `degraded`, version numbers, active counts, or Required form flags). Inline metadata tags pinned cleanly beside card titles or table row states.
- Anatomy: `<Badge variant="success" dot>Operational</Badge>`
- Metadata: Shrink-wrapped operational telemetry pill with optional pulse indicator. | Variants: default, secondary, destructive, outline, success, warning | Sizes: default, sm | Props: dot

### Breadcrumb (`@/components/ui/breadcrumb`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/breadcrumb.md`
- Defining Constraint: Clarifies hierarchy levels cleanly without overflowing horizontal bars, marking the final destination with aria-current="page" instead of a link.
- Use When: Deep nested views, component reference pages, or file hierarchy detail screens. Orienting users two or more levels below top-level navigation.
- Anatomy: `<Breadcrumb> <BreadcrumbList> <BreadcrumbItem> <BreadcrumbLink href="/">Home</BreadcrumbLink> </BreadcrumbItem> <BreadcrumbSeparator /> <BreadcrumbItem> <BreadcrumbPage>Primitives</BreadcrumbPage> </BreadcrumbItem> </BreadcrumbList> </Breadcrumb>`
- Metadata: Hierarchical location trail with kinetic directional separators. | Props: asChild, separator

### Button (`@/components/ui/button`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/button.md`
- Defining Constraint: Locks horizontal button footprint with an invisible ghost sizer across idle, loading, success, and error states while compressing immediately on pointerdown.
- Use When: Triggering immediate actions, form submissions, or asynchronous mutations with Promise lifecycle feedback. Presenting primary, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, or warning actions with proportional icon affinity.
- Anatomy: `<Button variant="default" size="default" leftIcon={<SparklesIcon size={16} />}> Publish </Button>`
- Metadata: Tactile action primitive with 9 visual variants, pointerdown yield, and async promise lifecycle. | Variants: default, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link, success, warning, glass | Sizes: xs, sm, default, lg, xl, icon-xs, icon-sm, icon, icon-lg | Props: children, disableTapScale, errorDuration, errorText, fluidMorph, fullWidth, iconTrigger, isLoading

### Calendar (`@/components/ui/calendar`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/calendar.md`
- Defining Constraint: Renders keyboard-navigable month grids with spring horizontal slide transitions and tabular-nums date cells, pairing directly with DatePicker popovers.
- Use When: Scheduling views, release windows, filter date selection, and inline month calendars. Forms requiring visual day-of-week awareness via Calendar or DatePicker.
- Anatomy: `<Calendar selected={selectedDate} onSelect={setSelectedDate} />`
- Metadata: Interactive month calendar grid with spring transition paging. | Props: className, disabled, disabledDates, maxDate, minDate, onSelect, placeholder, selected

### Callout (`@/components/ui/callout`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/callout.md`
- Defining Constraint: Highlights non-negotiable architectural constraints, semantic tips, or operational warnings in OKLCH-tinted blocks without decorative eyebrow pill clutter.
- Use When: Calling out defining constraints, breaking invariant rules, tips, or caution notices inside guides. Surfacing high-signal validation reminders directly alongside runnable code examples.
- Anatomy: `<Callout variant="defining-constraint" title="Zero Layout Shift"> Reserve border width on resting states. </Callout>`
- Metadata: Editorial admonition surface with semantic OKLCH variants including defining constraints. | Variants: note, tip, warning, caution, defining-constraint | Props: children, icon, title

### Card (`@/components/ui/card`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/card.md`
- Defining Constraint: Enforces mathematical concentric corner continuity via CardInner inside Card alongside subtle 1px specular rim lighting; avoid defaulting every layout to 3-card grids.
- Use When: Bounded workspace modules, detail inspectors, or distinct nested settings panels. Bento showcase items pairing CardHeader chrome with concentric CardInner nesting.
- Anatomy: `<Card> <CardHeader> <CardTitle>Cluster Node</CardTitle> <CardDescription>Edge configuration status.</CardDescription> </CardHeader> <CardContent> <CardInner>Inner concentric container</CardInner> </CardContent> </Card>`
- Metadata: Concentric container surface with specular rim lighting and inner card nesting. | Props: specular

### Chart (`@/components/ui/chart`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/chart.md`
- Defining Constraint: Renders zero-dependency perceptual OKLCH SVG Sparklines, AreaCharts, and BarCharts scaled crisply with tabular metric axes.
- Use When: Latency sparklines, throughput trendlines, contrast bounds, and daily activity bars. Telemetry panels needing lightweight OKLCH SVGs without external chart library overhead.
- Anatomy: `<AreaChart data={series} height={120} valueFormatter={(v) => `${v} ms`} />`
- Metadata: Zero-dependency OKLCH vector sparklines, area visualisations, and bar charts. | Props: data, className, color, fill, height, primaryColor, secondaryColor, showGrid

### Checkbox (`@/components/ui/checkbox`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/checkbox.md`
- Defining Constraint: Expands hit area with an invisible 44px touch target around a crisp rounded indicator supporting checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.
- Use When: Multi-select option lists, table row selection, or opt-in policy acknowledgements inside forms. Parent-child selection trees requiring an indeterminate mixed state.
- Anatomy: `<label className="inline-flex items-center gap-2.5"> <Checkbox checked={agreed} onCheckedChange={setAgreed} /> <span>Accept terms</span> </label>`
- Metadata: Tri-state accessible checkbox with 44px touch hit target expansion. | Props: size

### CodeBlock (`@/components/ui/code-block`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/code-block.md`
- Defining Constraint: Frames concentric code viewports (`rounded-2xl` outer, `rounded-[10px]` inner) with tabular-nums line gutters, focus line highlights, SegmentedControl tabs, and CopyButton.
- Use When: Presenting verified source snippets, CLI command tabs (Install / Verify), and highlighted config blocks. Side-by-side multi-framework installation tabs powered by SegmentedControl.
- Anatomy: `<CodeBlock filename="verify.sh" language="bash" highlightLines={[2]} code="npm run docs:build npm run check" />`
- Metadata: Concentric syntax viewport with tabular line numbers, line highlights, and multi-tab switcher. | Props: caption, code, copyable, defaultTab, filename, highlightLines, language, maxHeight

### Combobox (`@/components/ui/combobox`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/combobox.md`
- Defining Constraint: Pairs a filterable text input with a headless Base UI listbox popup supporting keyboard type-ahead and empty state feedback.
- Use When: Choosing one or more options from large sets (more than 10 items) where users type to filter. Country pickers, model selectors, or filterable tag selectors.
- Anatomy: `<Combobox items={frameworks} value={value} onValueChange={setValue}> <ComboboxInput aria-label="Select framework" placeholder="Search..." /> <ComboboxContent> <ComboboxList> <ComboboxItem value="React">React</ComboboxItem> <ComboboxEmpty>No matches found.</ComboboxEmpty> </ComboboxList> </ComboboxContent> </Combobox>`
- Metadata: Searchable autocomplete selector with keyboard roving navigation. | Props: clearable, icon, portal, sideOffset, size

### Command (`@/components/ui/command`)

- Use When: Application-wide ⌘K command palettes, quick navigation jumps, and action search. Filtering structured commands grouped under headings with keyboard arrows.

- Metadata: Global command palette modal with instant filtering and keycap hints. | Props: children, onOpenChange, open

### NavigationBar (`@/components/ui/navigation-bar`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/navigation-bar.md`
- Defining Constraint: Prevents header text truncation and crowding using container queries, minimum 220px submenu columns, explicit popover width bases, and automatic overflow harvesting.
- Use When: Global top application headers combining branding, mega-menu flyouts, direct route links, and utility actions. Responsive headers transitioning smoothly to a Sheet navigation drawer on narrow mobile screens.
- Anatomy: `<NavigationBar brand={<span>Design System</span>} items={navItems} maxVisibleItems={4} actions={<ThemeToggle isDark={isDark} onToggleDark={setIsDark} />} />`
- Metadata: Responsive top navigation rail with mega menus, columns, and bounded overflow harvesting. | Props: id, label, title, actions, align, badge, brand, children

### NumberTicker (`@/components/ui/number-ticker`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/number-ticker.md`
- Defining Constraint: Interpolates numeric changes via calibrated spring deceleration while enforcing font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so column digits never vibrate.
- Use When: Live KPI telemetry counters, build pass totals, contrast score indicators, and odometer readouts. Tabular metric cards or Stepper value displays requiring smooth spring transitions.
- Anatomy: `<NumberTicker value={99.4} decimalPlaces={1} suffix="%" />`
- Metadata: Tabular numeral spring counter preventing horizontal digit jitter. | Props: value, decimalPlaces, prefix, suffix

### Pagination (`@/components/ui/pagination`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/pagination.md`
- Defining Constraint: Formats numeric page counters with tabular-nums and frames active pages via colour contrast rather than weight shifts so buttons never jitter across pages.
- Use When: Stepping through server-backed or large client collections split into deterministic pages. Icon galleries, audit log tables, and search result sets.
- Anatomy: `<Pagination currentPage={page} totalPages={8} onPageChange={setPage} />`
- Metadata: Paged collection controller with compact numeric and worded triggers. | Props: buttonVariant, children, currentPage, disabled, iconOnly, isActive, label, layoutId

### Popover (`@/components/ui/popover`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/popover.md`
- Defining Constraint: Anchors non-modal interactive overlays with automatic viewport collision avoidance while letting outside clicks dismiss naturally.
- Use When: Date pickers, inline filter panels, share dialogues, or compact configuration forms. Trigger-anchored interactive mini-panels that keep surrounding context visible.
- Anatomy: `<Popover> <PopoverTrigger className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}>Configure</PopoverTrigger> <PopoverContent> <PopoverHeader> <PopoverTitle>Grid Snap</PopoverTitle> <PopoverDescription>Adjust snapping granularity.</PopoverDescription> </PopoverHeader> </PopoverContent> </Popover>`
- Metadata: Collision-aware floating overlay anchored cleanly to its trigger. | Props: align, alignOffset, anchor, collisionAvoidance, disableAnchorTracking, portalProps, side, sideOffset

### Progress (`@/components/ui/progress`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/progress.md`
- Defining Constraint: Translates percentage progress linearly or radially using compositor transforms rather than width reflows across smooth spring updates.
- Use When: File uploads, build pipeline stages, and bounded completion indicators (`0` to `100`). Compact radial completion indicators using CircularProgress beside status labels.
- Anatomy: `<Progress value={72} aria-label="Bundle compilation" />`
- Metadata: Deterministic linear progress bar and radial gauge with smooth spring interpolation. | Props: showValue, size, strokeWidth, value

### PropTable (`@/components/ui/prop-table`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/prop-table.md`
- Defining Constraint: Renders anti-crush TypeScript prop specifications inside a responsive Table using shrink-0 Required badges and tabular default indicators.
- Use When: Documenting exported TypeScript *Props interfaces extracted by AST or authored manually. Comparing prop names, union type strings, default values, and Required flags cleanly.
- Anatomy: `<PropTable title="ButtonProps" props={[{ name: "variant", type: '"default" | "outline"', defaultValue: '"default"', description: "Selects visual button role." }]} />`
- Metadata: Anti-crush TypeScript API reference table displaying props, types, defaults, and required pills. | Props: props, caption, emptyMessage, title

### RadioGroup (`@/components/ui/radio-group`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/radio-group.md`
- Defining Constraint: Enforces single-choice mutual exclusion across visible options with arrow-key roving focus and a smooth spring indicator dot.

### Resizable (`@/components/ui/resizable`)

### Sheet (`@/components/ui/sheet`)

### Skeleton (`@/components/ui/skeleton`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/skeleton.md`
- Defining Constraint: Mirrors the exact target component geometry before hydration or async data resolves to maintain zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
- Use When: Initial loading states matching exact card, text row, or avatar proportions. Async route transitions needing zero-CLS placeholders until streamed data arrives.
- Anatomy: `<div className="flex items-center gap-3"> <Skeleton className="size-10 rounded-full" /> <div className="space-y-2"> <Skeleton className="h-4 w-40" /> <Skeleton className="h-3 w-24" /> </div> </div>`
- Metadata: Zero-CLS dimensionally stable loading placeholder surface. | Props: shimmer

### Tooltip (`@/components/ui/tooltip`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/tooltip.md`
- Defining Constraint: Presents micro plain-text clarifications on icon buttons and keyboard shortcuts within a shared TooltipProvider warmup window.
- Use When: Explaining icon-only controls, displaying keyboard shortcuts (`⌘K`), or clarifying truncated telemetry codes. Lightweight micro-hints on hover or keyboard focus without adding visible chrome.
- Anatomy: `<TooltipProvider delay={150}> <Tooltip> <TooltipTrigger aria-label="Show help" className={buttonVariants({ size: "icon-sm", variant: "ghost" })}>?</TooltipTrigger> <TooltipContent>Inspect shortcut</TooltipContent> </Tooltip> </TooltipProvider>`
- Metadata: Compact contextual hint surface with configurable hover delay. | Props: align, portalProps, showArrow, side, sideOffset

### Tree (`@/components/ui/tree`)
- Spec: `public/docs/components/tree.md`
- Defining Constraint: Renders recursive hierarchical file and symbol trees with spring branch expansion, explicit ARIA treeitem levels, and full arrow-key navigation.
- Use When: File explorers, design token hierarchy browsers, and nested symbol directories. Expandable directory structures navigable with keyboard arrow keys.
- Anatomy: `<Tree data={nodes} defaultExpandedIds={["src"]} onSelectNode={handleSelect} />`
- Metadata: Hierarchical file and folder tree with spring expand/collapse motion. | Props: data, defaultExpandedIds, onSelect, selectedId

## 5. Workspace Agent Skills (8)

- app-blueprint (skills/app-blueprint/SKILL.md, v1.0.0): Use when building a complete application screen, multi-page product, or documented feature with this design system. Never use for single utility functions or non-UI backend scripts.
- base-ui-primitives (skills/base-ui-primitives/SKILL.md, v1.0.0): Use when building or auditing accessible headless UI primitives with @base-ui/react, compound slots, keyboard roving navigation, focus traps, and WCAG 2.2 states.
- craft-philosophy (skills/craft-philosophy/SKILL.md, v1.0.0): Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI components and screens. Enforces human-centric craft, 9-state interactive matrices, and anti-slop geometry.
- diagram-architecture (skills/diagram-architecture/SKILL.md, v1.0.0): Use when designing, drawing, or auditing technical diagrams, system schematics, flowcharts, and accessible SVGs. Enforces orthogonal routing and node budgets.
- motion-physics (skills/motion-physics/SKILL.md, v1.0.0): Use when animating UI transitions, gestures, modals, or active states with motion/react. Enforces calibrated spring physics, pointerdown yield, and velocity.
- production-deployment (skills/production-deployment/SKILL.md, v1.0.0): Use when preparing web interfaces for production deployment. Enforces Speculation Rules, View Transitions, SWR edge caching, safe-area insets, and zero-CLS.
- semantic-theming (skills/semantic-theming/SKILL.md, v1.0.0): Use when creating, styling, or auditing design tokens and themes. Enforces perceptual OKLCH colour spaces, Tailwind CSS v4 @theme inline, and APCA contrast.
- technical-documentation (skills/technical-documentation/SKILL.md, v1.0.0): Use when authoring, editing, or auditing technical docs, READMEs, ADRs, changelogs, and API guides. Enforces concept grounding, active prose, and drift gates.
